value.text: The captured Dashboard source serves a home page and saved weather-card JSON, forwards place-save and refresh requests to Places, and subscribes to weather.place-requested and weather.forecast-updated. The consumer dispatches each message to validation and event handling. In a transaction, applyEvent first inserts the event id into inbox; a duplicate commits and returns before any weather_cards upsert. A new place request updates place details. A forecast event inserts a missing card, or updates a conflicting card only when its stored updated_at is null or the incoming updatedAt is strictly newer; an older or equal event can commit its inbox row without changing the card. The health handler probes PostgreSQL and checks a local consumerReady flag. These statements describe source paths and declared registrations, not runtime activation.
